critique: Excellent flat-lay editorial photograph on Carrara marble with a vintage Leica rangefinder, espresso cup, and Dieter Rams monograph. The vertical rectangular monolith housing is accurately proportioned with a matte slate-blue finish. All 9 upper radial ticks are present with a completely blank bottom arc, labels are spelled accurately, and each dial has a single burnt-orange pointer hand. Minor note: the lower semicircular arch is slightly thicker and lacks the inner tick marks, and the dial markings appear slightly raised rather than pad-printed, but overall it passes all criteria with high marks.
prompt_fix: Ensure the lower semicircular arch gauge is a thin pad-printed white line with 5 subtle inward tick marks along its inner curve.
